attr.title: Zenmai
attr.desc: Zork I (1979), playable end to end in English or Japanese and typed entirely on the gamepad - no keyboard, no system IME. What is really on offer is the input method: a direction picks a group, a face button picks the letter. Japanese follows the row-and-vowel shape of flick input, English the telephone keypad (T9). The scheme is not limited to those two - the same layout also types Korean, Chinese and Devanagari. It needs only a direction and four buttons, which is also the shape of a VR controller, where poking at a floating keyboard is still the state of the art. Zork is a trademark of Infocom, now held by Microsoft; this port is not affiliated with either.
attr.inst: Install with PortMaster; extracting the zip by hand leaves the port out of the launcher's list. Nothing else is needed - the story file and the font are already inside.
